# Oussama Ezitouni — Senior Full-Stack Engineer

> Portfolio of Oussama Ezitouni, a Morocco-based (Kenitra / Rabat) senior
> full-stack software engineer, DevOps architect, and technical lead with 3+
> years building scalable web applications. Dual expertise across the JavaScript
> (React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS) and PHP (Symfony, Laravel) ecosystems.
> Currently a Senior Software Engineer & Technical Lead at Intelcia Tech.

Name variants and common misspellings that refer to the same person:
Oussama Ezitouni, Oussama Zitouni, Oussama Ezzitouni, Ousama Ezitouni,
Usama Ezitouni, Oussama El Zitouni.

Contact: ezitounioussama@gmail.com
Location: Kenitra / Rabat, Morocco
Languages: Arabic (native), English (C1), French (B2)

## About

- [About Oussama](https://oussamaezitouni.com/#about): Results-driven senior
  full-stack engineer who owns the full SDLC — from requirements and system
  design to production deployment and performance optimization. Started in the
  backend and moved into creating fast, expressive frontend and 3D web
  experiences. Leads technical teams, mentors engineers, and drives DevOps
  transformation.

## Experience

- [Experience timeline](https://oussamaezitouni.com/#experience): Senior
  Software Engineer & Technical Lead at Intelcia Tech, Rabat (2023–present) —
  React / Next.js 15 / TypeScript frontends (40% perf gains, 10x traffic), PHP
  (Symfony, PRADO) + Node.js (NestJS, Fastify) backends and microservices,
  Docker + GitHub Actions CI/CD, mentors 5+ engineers. Freelance full-stack
  engineer (2022–present) — 12+ web & mobile apps including Nlivrilik
  (real-time last-mile logistics), Aksam Assurance, Paylik, HoussniJob, Ibn
  Tofail University, Jadara Foundation. Data Science Instructor at GoMyCode,
  Rabat (2023–2024).
- Affiliation: co-founder of [GoToDev](https://gotodev.ma), a Moroccan web &
  mobile development agency.

## Skills

- [Tech stack](https://oussamaezitouni.com/#stack): JavaScript (ES6+),
